title: Hutch Removal Services
h1: Professional Hutch Removal Services You Can Count On

blocks.text: Professional Hutch Removal Services You Can Count On
Heavy, bulky, glass-fronted — we remove it all, safely.

items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: A hutch is one of the trickiest pieces of furniture to get out of a home. Between the solid wood construction, fragile glass doors, mirrored backs, and two-piece designs that weigh hundreds of pounds, moving one on your own is a recipe for injured backs and shattered glass. That’s where our dedicated hutch removal service comes in. Whether it’s a dining room hutch, a kitchen hutch, a buffet and hutch combo, or a corner hutch, our team dismantles, lifts, and hauls it away without a scratch on your home.

Every job begins with a free, no-obligation quote, so pricing is clear before we lift a thing. Serving homeowners across the Greater Toronto Area, we make hutch disposal quick, affordable, and environmentally responsible — so that empty dining room corner is finally yours again.

blocks.text: That Bulky Hutch Doesn't Have to Stay Another Day

c: Old hutches tend to linger for years, not because anyone wants them, but because nobody knows how to get them out. They’re too heavy for the curb, too big for a car, and too fragile to wrestle down a staircase. Our crew solves that in a single visit. We separate the top and base, secure or remove glass panels, and carry each section out with proper equipment and padding.

For hutches that have reached the end of their life, we make sure disposal is done right. Solid wood is recycled or repurposed, glass and hardware are sorted for processing, and hutches in good condition are donated to families and charities that can use them. Nothing gets dumped when it can be diverted.
Curious what hutch removal costs? We provide free, accurate estimates upfront — no vague ranges, no surprises on arrival.

b: Ready to open up that room?

blocks.text: Safe, Careful Hutch Removal – Book Today, Gone Today

c: Hutches aren’t ordinary furniture. Many are two-piece units where the display top sits loosely on the buffet base — lift it wrong and the whole thing topples. Add glass shelving, mirrored panels, and 150+ pounds of hardwood, and you have a job that genuinely requires professionals.

At Live Junk Free, hutch removal is something we do week in, week out. Whether you’re renovating the dining room, settling an estate, preparing a home for sale, or simply replacing dated furniture with a modern sideboard, we work around your timeline with same-day and next-day availability.

Our crews arrive with furniture dollies, lifting straps, moving blankets, and glass-handling experience. We assess the exit route before touching the piece, disassemble where it makes the job safer, and protect banisters, walls, and flooring the entire way out — including from condos, townhomes, and tight basement stairwells.

items: Careful disassembly – Tops separated from bases, glass secured or removed before carrying
Responsible disposal – Wood recycled, glass and metal processed, usable hutches donated locally

c: Browse real transformations from dining rooms, kitchens, and basements across the GTA. That massive hutch dominating the wall? Gone in under an hour, leaving a clean, open space ready for whatever comes next.

a: Yes — two-piece units are our specialty. We separate the display top from the buffet base, secure or remove any glass, and carry each section out individually. This keeps the piece stable and your home protected throughout the removal.

items.q: 2) What if my hutch has glass doors or mirrors?
a: No problem. Our crews are trained in handling glass-front hutches. Depending on the unit, we either remove the panels beforehand or secure them with padding and film so nothing shatters during transport.

items.q: 3) Do you take heavy antique or solid oak hutches?
a: Absolutely. Weight is never an issue — we bring dollies, lifting straps, and enough manpower for even the heaviest solid wood pieces. If an antique is in sellable or donatable condition, we’ll route it to a second home rather than disposal.

items.q: 4) Can you get a hutch out of a condo, apartment, or basement?
a: Yes. We regularly remove large hutches from high-rises, tight townhome staircases, and finished basements. We coordinate elevator bookings with building management where required and protect all common areas along the exit route.
